stories.headline: Russia's Novaya Gazeta shuts down under government pressure
body: Investigative paper Novaya Gazeta held its last editorial meeting and closed its newsroom.
Authorities had labelled it a 'foreign agent'.
It was one of the last Russian outlets criticising the war in Ukraine.
stories.vc: Fewer independent outlets make Russia harder for investors to read.

stories.headline: France blames Iran for hacking supermarket and blood-bank freezers
body: France formally blamed Iran for cyberattacks on thousands of connected fridges and freezers in Europe.
Targets included grocery stores and blood banks.
The US linked similar attacks to pro-Iran hackers.
stories.vc: Connected equipment is now a security cost for retailers and hospitals.

stories.headline: Thick smog covers Delhi after Diwali crackers
body: Smog blanketed New Delhi after people burst firecrackers for Diwali despite restrictions.
Air quality topped 350 in several areas, the 'severe' level.
It worsened the city's yearly pollution crisis.
stories.vc: Bad air costs India billions in health care and lost work every year.

stories.headline: Muhurat trading ends a seven-day rally, just barely
body: The Sensex slipped 28.62 points to 80,999 in Sunday's special Diwali Muhurat session.
It started Samvat 2083, the new Hindu calendar year.
stories.joke: Barely red. Call it a rounding error.
stories.vc: Muhurat trading is symbolic, but it sets the tone for the new year.

stories.headline: Sexual assault survivors' pelvic pain is often dismissed, even by doctors
body: Many sexual assault survivors live with pelvic pain that goes untreated, The 19th reports.
Medical bias and low awareness keep them from getting help.
Many of these conditions are very treatable.
stories.vc: Women's health gaps like this are a growing area for specialist care and investment.
